Initial release of the control-assessment skill.

- Enables evaluation of individual framework controls against organizational documentation.
- Automatically extracts and maps relevant evidence from documents to specific controls.
- Classifies coverage status (covered, partial, gap) based on detailed assessment rubrics.
- Assigns severity and remediation priority for identified gaps.
- Generates actionable remediation recommendations proportional to gap severity.
- Standardizes outputs for easy review and audit tracing.
